keyPoints.en: aᵐ × aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ; aᵐ ÷ aⁿ = aᵐ⁻ⁿ; (aᵐ)ⁿ = aᵐⁿ; (ab)ⁿ = aⁿbⁿ.
keyPoints.bm: aᵐ × aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ; aᵐ ÷ aⁿ = aᵐ⁻ⁿ; (aᵐ)ⁿ = aᵐⁿ; (ab)ⁿ = aⁿbⁿ.

keyPoints.en: Index equations: write both sides with the same base, then equate indices.
keyPoints.bm: Persamaan indeks: tulis kedua-dua belah dengan asas sama, kemudian samakan indeks.

keyPoints.en: Equations like 4ˣ − 2ˣ − 2 = 0: let u = 2ˣ to get a quadratic.
keyPoints.bm: Persamaan seperti 4ˣ − 2ˣ − 2 = 0: biar u = 2ˣ untuk mendapat kuadratik.

keyPoints.en: A surd is an irrational root, e.g. √2, √5. (√4 = 2 is not a surd.)
keyPoints.bm: Surd ialah punca tak nisbah, cth. √2, √5. (√4 = 2 bukan surd.)

keyPoints.en: Simplify by taking out square factors: √72 = √(36 × 2) = 6√2.
keyPoints.bm: Permudahkan dengan mengeluarkan faktor kuasa dua: √72 = √(36 × 2) = 6√2.

keyPoints.en: Rationalise: multiply by √a for 1/√a, or by the conjugate (a − √b) for 1/(a + √b).
keyPoints.bm: Nisbahkan: darab dengan √a bagi 1/√a, atau dengan konjugat (a − √b) bagi 1/(a + √b).

tip.en: Leave answers in surd form when the question says 'exact value'.
tip.bm: Biarkan jawapan dalam bentuk surd apabila soalan meminta 'nilai tepat'.

keyPoints.en: aˣ = N ⇔ logₐ N = x (a > 0, a ≠ 1). log means base 10; ln means base e.
keyPoints.bm: aˣ = N ⇔ logₐ N = x (a > 0, a ≠ 1). log bermakna asas 10; ln bermakna asas e.

keyPoints.en: Product: logₐ xy = logₐ x + logₐ y. Quotient: logₐ (x/y) = logₐ x − logₐ y.
keyPoints.bm: Hasil darab: logₐ xy = logₐ x + logₐ y. Hasil bahagi: logₐ (x/y) = logₐ x − logₐ y.

keyPoints.en: Power: logₐ xⁿ = n logₐ x. Special: logₐ 1 = 0, logₐ a = 1.
keyPoints.bm: Kuasa: logₐ xⁿ = n logₐ x. Khas: logₐ 1 = 0, logₐ a = 1.

keyPoints.en: Change of base: logₐ b = log b / log a = 1 / log_b a.
keyPoints.bm: Penukaran asas: logₐ b = log b / log a = 1 / log_b a.

keyPoints.en: Log equations: combine into a single log on each side, then remove logs (or convert to index form).
keyPoints.bm: Persamaan log: gabungkan menjadi satu log di setiap belah, kemudian buang log (atau tukar kepada bentuk indeks).

answer.en: log₂ (x² − 1) = 3 → x² − 1 = 8 → x = 3 (reject −3 since logs need positive values).
answer.bm: log₂ (x² − 1) = 3 → x² − 1 = 8 → x = 3 (tolak −3 kerana log memerlukan nilai positif).

tip.en: Always check your answer — log of a negative number or zero is undefined.
tip.bm: Sentiasa semak jawapan — log nombor negatif atau sifar tidak tertakrif.

keyPoints.en: When bases can't be made equal, take logs of both sides: aˣ = b → x = log b / log a.
keyPoints.bm: Apabila asas tidak boleh disamakan, ambil log kedua-dua belah: aˣ = b → x = log b / log a.

keyPoints.en: Compound interest / growth: A = P(1 + r)ⁿ. Decay: A = P(1 − r)ⁿ.
keyPoints.bm: Faedah kompaun / pertumbuhan: A = P(1 + r)ⁿ. Susutan: A = P(1 − r)ⁿ.

keyPoints.en: Applications: population growth, bacterial growth, radioactive decay, depreciation of a car's value.
keyPoints.bm: Aplikasi: pertumbuhan populasi, pertumbuhan bakteria, reputan radioaktif, susut nilai kereta.

keyPoints.en: pH = −log[H⁺] and the Richter scale are logarithmic scales.
keyPoints.bm: pH = −log[H⁺] dan skala Richter ialah skala logaritma.

question.en: A car worth RM80 000 loses 15% of its value every year. After how many full years is it worth less than RM40 000?
question.bm: Sebuah kereta bernilai RM80 000 susut 15% setiap tahun. Selepas berapa tahun penuh nilainya kurang daripada RM40 000?

tip.en: Dividing by a negative log (like log 0.85) flips the inequality sign!
tip.bm: Membahagi dengan log negatif (seperti log 0.85) menyongsangkan tanda ketaksamaan!
